meta.title: Devices
meta.description: Manage the devices that do the work: pair the browser extension, watch task status, and fire a test echo task.
meta.keywords: devices, browser extension, execution tasks, auto publishing, AiToEarn

page.title: Devices
page.subtitle: The browser extension runs on your computer and picks up work from the server

empty.title: No devices yet
empty.desc: A device is the browser extension installed on your computer. It stays connected to the server, picks up work, and does the publishing and data collection on the platforms.
empty.hint: Click Add device to get a pairing code, then enter it in the extension.

device.noCapabilities: The extension has not reported any capability yet
device.noAccounts: The extension has not reported any account yet
device.loadFailed: The device list did not load. Please try again.

recentTasks.empty: This device has not picked up any task yet
recentTasks.loadFailed: Recent tasks did not load. Please try again.

pair.title: Add device
pair.desc: Enter this pairing code in the browser extension. Once paired, the device shows up in the list.
pair.step1: Open the AiToEarn browser extension on your computer
pair.step2: Find device pairing and enter the code above
pair.step3: Come back here and refresh to see the device
pair.expired: This code has expired. Get a new one.
pair.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the code and copy it manually.
pair.generateFailed: No pairing code yet. Try again below.

rename.title: Rename device
rename.desc: Only the name changes. Capabilities and accounts are reported by the extension.
rename.label: Device name
rename.emptyError: The device name cannot be empty

revoke.title: Revoke this device?
revoke.desc: Revoking kills the token of "{{name}}" right away. It can no longer pick up work or report results, and it has to be paired again to come back.

tasks.loadFailed: The task list did not load. Please try again.
tasks.cancelConfirmDesc: Once cancelled, no device can pick it up. A run already in progress is not interrupted, but its result will not be accepted.

empty.title: No tasks yet
empty.desc: A task is a job handed to a device. To check the chain end to end, create an echo task: the device picks it up and sends the message straight back. A successful report means the chain works.

detail.title: Task details
detail.desc: Payload and result differ by task type and are shown as they are.
detail.loadFailed: The task details did not load. Please try again.

echo.title: New echo task
echo.desc: The device picks it up and sends the message straight back. Use it to check the chain: the web app creates the task, the extension picks it up, the result comes back.
echo.messagePlaceholder: Anything. The device sends it back unchanged.
echo.noProject: No active project yet. Create one on the Projects page first.
echo.loadProjectFailed: The project list did not load. Please try again.

error.network: Network unavailable. Check your connection and try again.
error.unknown: That did not work. Please try again.
error.pairingCodeGenerateFailed: The pairing code could not be created. Please try again.
error.deviceNotFound: This device is gone. It may have been revoked.
error.deviceRevoked: This device was revoked. Pair it again to use it.
error.deviceNameInvalid: The device name is not allowed. Adjust it and try again.
error.deviceLimitExceeded: You have reached the device limit.
error.taskNotFound: This task is gone. Refresh to see the current list.
error.taskStatusInvalid: The current status does not allow this action.
error.taskTypeNotSupported: This task type is not supported.
error.taskPayloadInvalid: The task payload is not valid.

error.taskCancelNotAllowed: This task cannot be cancelled right now.
error.taskRetryNotAllowed: This task cannot be retried right now.
error.taskMaxAttemptsExceeded: All retries have been used up.
error.taskProjectMismatch: This task belongs to a different project.
